label: Today You Will Learn
h: How to check your body before you interpret your mind, and when a pattern belongs to a doctor rather than a journal.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

If you have had thoughts of not wanting to be alive, please use Get help now under this lesson today. This lesson can wait. You cannot.

label: Key Scripture
h: "And behold, an angel touched him and said to him, 'Arise and eat.'"

label: Meet Joseph
h: A spiritual crisis. Four hours' sleep a night. A two-week chest infection.
body: <svg class="art" viewBox="0 0 360 200" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M40 40a30 30 0 1 0 26 44 24 24 0 0 1-26-44z" fill="#c78a2c"/><rect x="120" y="20" width="120" height="170" rx="18" fill="#3b4a60"/><rect x="132" y="36" width="96" height="130" rx="8" fill="#141c28"/><text class="t1" x="180" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#f7f3ec">calling…</text><text class="t2" x="180" y="120" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#c78a2c">11:40 pm</text><circle cx="300" cy="105" r="34" fill="none" stroke="#f7f3ec" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="300" y1="105" x2="300" y2="82" stroke="#f7f3ec" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="300" y1="105" x2="318" y2="105" stroke="#f7f3ec" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="300" y="165" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#b9c0cb">4 hrs sleep</text></svg>

label: What God Did First
body:
Sleep→Touch→Food and water→Sleep again→Then the conversation

God did not rebuke Elijah's despair or correct his theology. He fed him.

label: The Main Truth
h: You are not only a mind.
body: Be slow to draw conclusions about your faith or your future from an exhausted, hungry or unwell body.

label: The Tool · Check These Before You Interpret Your Mind
body:
SleepWeeks of stressSkipped mealsIllness or painCaffeineMedication changesLong seasons without rest

None of these is a sin. Each can make a restless mind more restless.

label: But Not The Whole Story
h: Food and sleep do not cure anxiety disorders. Treatment is what qualified professionals provide.
body: Physical causes and spiritual realities are not rivals.

label: Back To Joseph
h:
Eleven hours' sleep. A doctor's visit.
The questions became smaller and more specific.

label: Do This Now
h: Write down one thing for your body that you have been putting off.
body:
An earlier night. A proper meal. A walk. The appointment you have been avoiding. Then do it today.

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: The body is part of the story, not the whole of it.

label: Prayer
body:
Father, you made my body
and called it good.

You fed Elijah before you questioned him.

Teach me to rest, to eat, to ask for help,
and to call it faith.

Amen.
